title: Global Well-Posedness and Numerical Approximation of a Coupled Darcy-Convection-Diffusion System with Exponential Nonlinearity
summary: This paper investigates density driven flow in porous media, focusing on the roles of viscosity contrast, density contrast, and linear adsorption. In this setup, the fluid on top is heavier and more viscous than the fluid below. Under the effect of gravity, this system becomes unstable, and finger-like structures appear. The phenomenon is described mathematically by coupling Darcy's law with a convection-diffusion reaction equation.
